note: Frozen before any test split is touched: commit this file, the decision file below, configs/e15.json, the Haiku decision (results/e14/haiku_decision.json), the E5 and E6 outputs and configs/e9_wrong_disease.json first. The primary model (system 'improved') is the one the decision file names, scored on the decision's class list; every other candidate whose saved checkpoint is on disk is scored beside it as 'alternate' (and 'alternate_2'), each with its own calibration. Older models are restricted to the class list by masking the outputs of dropped classes and renormalizing. The other systems are named here.

xgboost.what: E3, HOG and colour histograms, trained on lab_train

dinov2.what: E4, DINOv2 small with a linear head, trained on the joint set

quantized.what: E6's quantized export of the chosen model; set `variant` to the export E6's final numbers pick

decision_schema: T4.9's results/e15/decision.json, read as written: chosen, chosen_checkpoint, chosen_checkpoint_sha256 and classes (the 29, in output order). The chosen checkpoint is the primary and must be one of the candidates (convnext_joint is e4, convnext_joint_extra is e12, convnextv2_final is e15, models/e15/final/best.pt); the other two are scored beside it. Its calibration is not named in the decision: it is <refit.out_dir>/chosen.json of configs/e15.json (results/e15/refit/chosen.json), which names model_sha256. A candidate that is not chosen has no calibration of its own except E4's and E12's earlier files. E9 refuses if the decision, configs/e15.json or the refit is absent or uncommitted.
